/* OneTap Header: Mega-Menü, Dropdowns, mobiles Menü (barrierefrei, ohne jQuery) */
(function () {
  var root = document.querySelector('.ot-site-header');
  if (!root) return;
  var desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)');
  var finePointer = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)');
  var menus = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[data-ot-menu]'));
  var closeTimer = null;

  function panelOf(btn) { return document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('aria-controls')); }
  function setOpen(btn, open) {
    var panel = panelOf(btn);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    panel.hidden = !open;
    /* Untermenü am rechten Rand nach links klappen */
    if (open && panel.classList.contains('ot-drop--sub')) {
      panel.classList.remove('ot-drop--flip');
      if (panel.getBoundingClientRect().right > document.documentElement.clientWidth - 8) panel.classList.add('ot-drop--flip');
    }
  }
  function closeSubs(scope) {
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-ot-sub] > button[aria-expanded="true"]').forEach(function (b) { setOpen(b, false); });
  }
  function closeAll(except) {
    menus.forEach(function (m) {
      var b = m.querySelector(':scope > button');
      if (m !== except && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') { setOpen(b, false); closeSubs(m); }
    });
  }

  menus.forEach(function (m) {
    var btn = m.querySelector(':scope > button');
    var hoverAt = 0;
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var open = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
      /* Gerade per Hover geöffnet: Klick lässt es offen statt es wieder zu schließen */
      if (!open && Date.now() - hoverAt < 700) return;
      closeAll(m);
      setOpen(btn, open);
      if (!open) closeSubs(m);
    });
    /* Hover nur mit Maus am Desktop, mit kurzer Verzögerung beim Schließen */
    m.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
      if (!desktop.matches || !finePointer.matches) return;
      clearTimeout(closeTimer);
      closeAll(m);
      if (btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') hoverAt = Date.now();
      setOpen(btn, true);
    });
    m.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
      if (!desktop.matches || !finePointer.matches) return;
      closeTimer = setTimeout(function () { setOpen(btn, false); closeSubs(m); }, 220);
    });
  });

  /* Scroll-Zustand: Promo-Leiste scrollt weg, Menü wechselt auf den Satz.
     Maus über dem Header oder Tastaturfokus holt das Menü zurück (CSS). */
  /* Sticky absichern: Theme- und Elementor-Wrapper können "sticky" verhindern.
     1) Ein Wrapper, der nur so hoch ist wie der Header, lässt ihm keinen Platz zum Kleben:
        Elementor-Wrapper direkt um den Header werden mit display: contents aus dem Layout genommen.
     2) overflow: hidden auf einem Vorfahren (oft html, body oder #page) schaltet sticky ab:
        Es wird durch overflow: clip ersetzt. Das schneidet genauso ab, lässt sticky aber wirken. */
  (function fixSticky() {
    var el = root.parentElement;
    while (el && el !== document.body && el !== document.documentElement) {
      var cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      var wrap = /(^|\s)(elementor|e-con|e-flex|elementor-widget)/.test(el.className || '');
      if (wrap && el.offsetHeight <= root.offsetHeight + 2 && cs.display !== 'contents') {
        el.style.setProperty('display', 'contents', 'important');
      }
      el = el.parentElement;
    }
    el = root.parentElement;
    while (el) {
      var s = getComputedStyle(el);
      if (s.overflowX === 'hidden') el.style.setProperty('overflow-x', 'clip', 'important');
      if (s.overflowY === 'hidden') el.style.setProperty('overflow-y', 'clip', 'important');
      if (el === document.documentElement) break;
      el = el.parentElement;
    }
  })();

  var promo = root.querySelector('.ot-promo');
  function setPromoH() { root.style.setProperty('--ot-promo-h', (promo && !promo.hidden ? promo.offsetHeight : 0) + 'px'); }

  /* Countdown der Promo-Leiste: pro Besucher data-days Tage, danach startet er neu */
  (function () {
    var out = promo && promo.querySelector('[data-ot-cd]');
    var span = promo ? parseFloat(promo.getAttribute('data-days')) * 86400000 : NaN;
    if (!out || !(span > 0)) return;
    var KEY = 'otPromoEnd', end = 0;
    try { end = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(KEY), 10) || 0; } catch (e) {}
    function restart() {
      end = Date.now() + span;
      try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, String(end)); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (end <= Date.now() || end - Date.now() > span) restart();
    var pad = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; };
    function tick() {
      var left = end - Date.now();
      if (left <= 0) { restart(); left = span; }
      var s = Math.floor(left / 1000), d = Math.floor(s / 86400);

      setTimeout(tick, 1000 - (Date.now() % 1000));
    }

    ticking = false;
    var y = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
    var next = scrolled ? y > 40 : y > 120; /* Abstand verhindert Flackern an der Grenze */
    if (next === scrolled) return;

  root.querySelectorAll('[data-ot-sub]').forEach(function (s) {

    var subHoverAt = 0;

      if (btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') subHoverAt = Date.now();
      setOpen(btn, true);
    });
    s.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { if (desktop.matches && finePointer.matches) setOpen(btn, false); });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('[data-ot-menu]')) closeAll(null);
  });

  /* Esc schließt und setzt den Fokus zurück; Fokus außerhalb schließt */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    var openSub = root.querySelector('[data-ot-sub] > button[aria-expanded="true"]');
    if (openSub && openSub.parentNode.contains(document.activeElement)) { setOpen(openSub, false); openSub.focus(); return; }

    if (burger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') { toggleMobile(false); burger.focus(); }
  });
  menus.forEach(function (m) {
    m.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
      if (e.relatedTarget && !m.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
        setOpen(m.querySelector(':scope > button'), false);
        closeSubs(m);
      }
    });
  });

  /* Mobiles Menü */
  var burger = root.querySelector('.ot-burger');
  var mobile = document.getElementById('ot-mobile');
  function toggleMobile(open) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ot-header-h', Math.round(root.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + 'px');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');

    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('ot-no-scroll', open);
    if (open) { var first = mobile.querySelector('summary, a'); if (first) first.focus(); }
  }
  burger.addEventListener('click', function () { toggleMobile(burger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'); });
  /* Fokus im offenen Menü halten */
  mobile.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
    var f = Array.prototype.filter.call(root.querySelectorAll('.ot-burger, #ot-mobile summary, #ot-mobile a'), function (el) { return el.offsetParent !== null; });

  });
  desktop.addEventListener('change', function (e) { if (e.matches) toggleMobile(false); closeAll(null); });

				( () => {
					const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();
			</script>

/* OneTap Header: Mega-Menü, Dropdowns, mobiles Menü (barrierefrei, ohne jQuery) */
(function () {
  var root = document.querySelector('.ot-site-header');
  if (!root) return;
  var desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)');
  var finePointer = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)');
  var menus = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[data-ot-menu]'));
  var closeTimer = null;

  function panelOf(btn) { return document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('aria-controls')); }
  function setOpen(btn, open) {
    var panel = panelOf(btn);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    panel.hidden = !open;
    /* Untermenü am rechten Rand nach links klappen */
    if (open && panel.classList.contains('ot-drop--sub')) {
      panel.classList.remove('ot-drop--flip');
      if (panel.getBoundingClientRect().right > document.documentElement.clientWidth - 8) panel.classList.add('ot-drop--flip');
    }
  }
  function closeSubs(scope) {
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-ot-sub] > button[aria-expanded="true"]').forEach(function (b) { setOpen(b, false); });
  }
  function closeAll(except) {
    menus.forEach(function (m) {
      var b = m.querySelector(':scope > button');
      if (m !== except && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') { setOpen(b, false); closeSubs(m); }
    });
  }

  menus.forEach(function (m) {
    var btn = m.querySelector(':scope > button');
    var hoverAt = 0;
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var open = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
      /* Gerade per Hover geöffnet: Klick lässt es offen statt es wieder zu schließen */
      if (!open && Date.now() - hoverAt < 700) return;
      closeAll(m);
      setOpen(btn, open);
      if (!open) closeSubs(m);
    });
    /* Hover nur mit Maus am Desktop, mit kurzer Verzögerung beim Schließen */
    m.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
      if (!desktop.matches || !finePointer.matches) return;
      clearTimeout(closeTimer);
      closeAll(m);
      if (btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') hoverAt = Date.now();
      setOpen(btn, true);
    });
    m.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
      if (!desktop.matches || !finePointer.matches) return;
      closeTimer = setTimeout(function () { setOpen(btn, false); closeSubs(m); }, 220);
    });
  });

     Maus über dem Header oder Tastaturfokus holt das Menü zurück (CSS). */
  /* Sticky absichern: Theme- und Elementor-Wrapper können "sticky" verhindern.
     1) Ein Wrapper, der nur so hoch ist wie der Header, lässt ihm keinen Platz zum Kleben:
        Elementor-Wrapper direkt um den Header werden mit display: contents aus dem Layout genommen.
     2) overflow: hidden auf einem Vorfahren (oft html, body oder #page) schaltet sticky ab:
        Es wird durch overflow: clip ersetzt. Das schneidet genauso ab, lässt sticky aber wirken. */
  (function fixSticky() {
    var el = root.parentElement;
    while (el && el !== document.body && el !== document.documentElement) {
      var cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      var wrap = /(^|\s)(elementor|e-con|e-flex|elementor-widget)/.test(el.className || '');
      if (wrap && el.offsetHeight <= root.offsetHeight + 2 && cs.display !== 'contents') {
        el.style.setProperty('display', 'contents', 'important');
      }
      el = el.parentElement;
    }
    el = root.parentElement;
    while (el) {
      var s = getComputedStyle(el);
      if (s.overflowX === 'hidden') el.style.setProperty('overflow-x', 'clip', 'important');

      el = el.parentElement;
    }

  /* Countdown der Promo-Leiste: pro Besucher data-days Tage, danach startet er neu */

    var KEY = 'otPromoEnd', end = 0;
    try { end = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(KEY), 10) || 0; } catch (e) {}
    function restart() {
      end = Date.now() + span;
      try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, String(end)); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (end <= Date.now() || end - Date.now() > span) restart();
    var pad = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; };
    function tick() {
      var left = end - Date.now();
      if (left <= 0) { restart(); left = span; }
      var s = Math.floor(left / 1000), d = Math.floor(s / 86400);
      out.textContent = (d ? d + 'd ' : '') + pad(Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24) + 'h ' +
        pad(Math.floor(s / 60) % 60) + 'm ' + pad(s % 60) + 's';

  setPromoH();
  window.addEventListener('resize', setPromoH);

    ticking = false;
    var y = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
    var next = scrolled ? y > 40 : y > 120; /* Abstand verhindert Flackern an der Grenze */
    if (next === scrolled) return;

  root.querySelectorAll('[data-ot-sub]').forEach(function (s) {
    var btn = s.querySelector(':scope > button');
    var subHoverAt = 0;
    btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {

      if (!open && Date.now() - subHoverAt < 700) return;
      setOpen(btn, open);
    });

      if (!desktop.matches || !finePointer.matches) return;
      if (btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') subHoverAt = Date.now();
      setOpen(btn, true);
    });
    s.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { if (desktop.matches && finePointer.matches) setOpen(btn, false); });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('[data-ot-menu]')) closeAll(null);
  });

  /* Esc schließt und setzt den Fokus zurück; Fokus außerhalb schließt */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    var openSub = root.querySelector('[data-ot-sub] > button[aria-expanded="true"]');
    if (openSub && openSub.parentNode.contains(document.activeElement)) { setOpen(openSub, false); openSub.focus(); return; }

    if (openBtn) { closeAll(null); openBtn.focus(); return; }
    if (burger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') { toggleMobile(false); burger.focus(); }
  });
  menus.forEach(function (m) {
    m.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
      if (e.relatedTarget && !m.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
        setOpen(m.querySelector(':scope > button'), false);
        closeSubs(m);
      }
    });
  });

  /* Mobiles Menü */
  var burger = root.querySelector('.ot-burger');
  var mobile = document.getElementById('ot-mobile');
  function toggleMobile(open) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ot-header-h', Math.round(root.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + 'px');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
    mobile.hidden = !open;
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('ot-no-scroll', open);
    if (open) { var first = mobile.querySelector('summary, a'); if (first) first.focus(); }
  }
  burger.addEventListener('click', function () { toggleMobile(burger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'); });

  mobile.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
    var f = Array.prototype.filter.call(root.querySelectorAll('.ot-burger, #ot-mobile summary, #ot-mobile a'), function (el) { return el.offsetParent !== null; });
    var first = f[0], last = f[f.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  });
  desktop.addEventListener('change', function (e) { if (e.matches) toggleMobile(false); closeAll(null); });
})();

<script>
/* Logos je Sprache: Sprache aus der GTranslate-Subdomain (de.wponetap.com), sonst aus <html lang>, sonst Englisch */
(function () {
  var bar = document.querySelector('.ot-root .ot-logos');
  if (!bar || bar.dataset.otLang) return;
  var part = location.hostname.split('.')[0];
  var sub = location.hostname.split('.').length > 2 && /^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]{2,4})?$/i.test(part) ? part : '';
  var lang = (sub || document.documentElement.lang || 'en').slice(0, 2).toLowerCase();
  var group = lang === 'de' ? 'de' : lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'other';
  bar.dataset.otLang = group;
  bar.querySelectorAll('.ot-logos__list li[data-lang]').forEach(function (li) {
    var l = li.getAttribute('data-lang');
    if (l !== 'intl' && l !== group) li.parentNode.removeChild(li);
  });
  var lists = bar.querySelectorAll('.ot-logos__list');
  var first = lists[0];
  /* Zu wenige für den Endlos-Lauf: ruhig nebeneinander, ohne Kopie */
  if (first && first.children.length < 6) {
    bar.classList.add('ot-logos--static');
    if (lists[1]) lists[1].parentNode.removeChild(lists[1]);
    return;
  }
  /* Kürzer als die Leiste: Logos wiederholen, sonst entsteht beim Lauf eine Lücke */
  var view = bar.querySelector('.ot-logos__viewport');
  var originals = first ? Array.prototype.slice.call(first.children) : [];
  function fill() {
    var rounds = 0;
    while (first.scrollWidth < view.clientWidth && rounds < 4) {
      rounds++;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(lists, function (list) {
        originals.forEach(function (li) {
          var c = li.cloneNode(true);
          c.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          var im = c.querySelector('img'); if (im) im.alt = '';
          list.appendChild(c);
        });
      });
    }
  }
  if (first && view) { fill(); window.addEventListener('resize', fill); }
})();
</script>

<script>
/* Zitat-Effekt: Wörter färben sich beim Scrollen ein (Seite scrollt normal weiter) */
(function () {
  var el = document.querySelector('.ot-quote__text p');
  if (!el || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

  /* Text in Wörter zerlegen; Elemente (z. B. <span class="notranslate">)
     bleiben erhalten und zählen als ein Wort */
  var spans = [];
  Array.prototype.slice.call(el.childNodes).forEach(function (node) {
    if (node.nodeType === 3) {
      var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      node.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(function (part) {
        if (!part) return;
        if (/^\s+$/.test(part)) { frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ')); return; }
        var s = document.createElement('span');
        s.className = 'ot-word';
        s.textContent = part;
        frag.appendChild(s);
        spans.push(s);
      });
      el.replaceChild(frag, node);
    } else if (node.nodeType === 1) {
      node.classList.add('ot-word');
      spans.push(node);
    }
  });
  el.classList.add('is-reveal');

  /* Start: Oberkante des Zitats bei 85 % der Fensterhöhe.
     Ende:  Oberkante bei 35 %. Kleinerer Abstand = schnellerer Effekt. */
  var START = 0.85, END = 0.35, ticking = false;

  function update() {
    ticking = false;
    var vh = window.innerHeight;
    var top = el.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    var p = (START * vh - top) / ((START - END) * vh);
    p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p));
    var n = Math.round(p * spans.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < spans.length; i++) spans[i].classList.toggle('is-on', i < n);
  }
  function onScroll() {
    if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); }
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
  update();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* Bewertungen: "Read all reviews" klappt die restlichen Karten auf, "Show fewer reviews" wieder zu */
(function () {
  var wall = document.querySelector('.ot-reviews__wall');
  if (!wall) return;
  var list = wall.querySelector('.ot-reviews__clip');
  var btn = wall.querySelector('.ot-reviews__more');
  var still = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  list.addEventListener('transitionend', function (e) {
    if (e.target === list && wall.classList.contains('is-open')) wall.classList.add('is-full');
  });
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var open = !wall.classList.contains('is-open');
    if (open) {
      list.style.setProperty('--ot-rev-h', list.scrollHeight + 'px');
      wall.classList.add('is-open');
      if (still.matches) wall.classList.add('is-full');
      btn.textContent = 'Show fewer reviews';
    } else {
      list.style.setProperty('--ot-rev-h', list.scrollHeight + 'px');
      wall.classList.remove('is-full');
      void list.offsetHeight; /* aktuelle Höhe festhalten, dann zurück animieren */
      wall.classList.remove('is-open');
      btn.textContent = 'Read all reviews';
      var top = wall.closest('.ot-reviews').getBoundingClientRect().top;
      if (top < 0) wall.closest('.ot-reviews').scrollIntoView({ behavior: still.matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    }
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
})();
</script>

						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();

      if (panel.getBoundingClientRect().right > document.documentElement.clientWidth - 8) panel.classList.add('ot-drop--flip');

     Maus über dem Header oder Tastaturfokus holt das Menü zurück (CSS). */

     1) Ein Wrapper, der nur so hoch ist wie der Header, lässt ihm keinen Platz zum Kleben:
        Elementor-Wrapper direkt um den Header werden mit display: contents aus dem Layout genommen.

  /* Countdown der Promo-Leiste: pro Besucher data-days Tage, danach startet er neu */

    var out = promo && promo.querySelector('[data-ot-cd]');
    var span = promo ? parseFloat(promo.getAttribute('data-days')) * 86400000 : NaN;

      try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, String(end)); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (end <= Date.now() || end - Date.now() > span) restart();
    var pad = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; };
    function tick() {

      var s = Math.floor(left / 1000), d = Math.floor(s / 86400);

  root.querySelectorAll('[data-ot-sub]').forEach(function (s) {

  });

  /* Klick daneben schließt */
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('[data-ot-menu]')) closeAll(null);
  });

    m.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {

      }
    });
  });

  var burger = root.querySelector('.ot-burger');
  var mobile = document.getElementById('ot-mobile');
  function toggleMobile(open) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ot-header-h', Math.round(root.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + 'px');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');

  });
  desktop.addEventListener('change', function (e) { if (e.matches) toggleMobile(false); closeAll(null); });

<h3>Our Approach to Accessibility</h3>
We aim to align with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), which define internationally recognized standards for digital accessibility. While full compliance cannot always be guaranteed, we strive to implement improvements where feasible and regularly review accessibility-related aspects of our website. 						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();

						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();
